title: 7.19.3 Lab: A run of enemies
description: Your hero fights a run of enemies made from KINDS with map: beating one levels you up and brings the next, and beating the last one wins.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: This is your game from 7.18.3: one goblin, and the game ends when it falls.
hints: If you brought your 7.18.3 work forward, your names may differ; keep yours. Where a step quotes a line, change the line of yours that does the same job.

steps.title: Kinds as data
steps.instructions: Above the class, add the list of kinds from the reading: `const KINDS = [ ... ];` with the Slime (`hp: 14, power: 3, potions: 0, color: 'limegreen'`), the Goblin (`hp: 24, power: 5, potions: 1, color: 'orange'`) and the Ogre (`hp: 36, power: 7, potions: 1, color: 'mediumpurple'`), each as `{ name: 'Slime', hp: 14, power: 3, potions: 0, color: 'limegreen' },`. Run: nothing changes yet, because nothing uses `KINDS`.
hints: `KINDS` holds plain objects, not Fighters: they are only numbers and words.

steps.title: Enemies from the kinds
steps.instructions: Below `let turn = 0;`, add `let enemies;` and `let which = 0;`. In `newGame()`, replace the line that makes the fighters with three lines: `enemies = KINDS.map((k) => new Fighter(k.name, k.hp, k.power, k.potions, k.color));`, then `which = 0;`, then `fighters = [new Fighter('Hero', 30, 3, 2, 'gold'), enemies[0]];`. Run: you face a Slime now. Beat it: the game still ends there.
hints: `k` is one kind, so `k.hp` is that kind's hp.
This goes in `newGame()`, not `setup()`, so R brings back fresh enemies with full hp.

steps.title: Level up
steps.instructions: In the class, below `heal()`, write `levelUp()` from the reading: `this.maxHp += 5;`, `this.hp = this.maxHp;`, `this.power += 1;` and `this.potions = 2;`. Nothing calls it yet.
hints: Raise `maxHp` first, then set `hp` to it, so you start the next fight full.

steps.title: The next enemy
steps.instructions: Replace the inside of `fightOver(winner)` with the three cases from the reading. A loss stays as it was: `if (winner === 1) { over = true; message = 'The ' + fighters[1].name + ' beat you. Press R to try again'; return; }`. Then the last enemy: `if (which === enemies.length - 1) { over = true; message = 'You beat them all! Press R to play again'; return; }`. Otherwise: `which += 1;`, `fighters[0].levelUp();`, `fighters[1] = enemies[which];`, `turn = 0;` and `message = 'Level up! Next: ' + fighters[1].name + '. Your turn';`. In `drawTop()`, below the message line, add `text('Fight ' + (which + 1) + ' of ' + enemies.length, 10, 46, 12, '#8393c4');`. Run: beat the Slime and the Goblin steps up, while you level up to 35 hp.
hints: Ask about the last enemy BEFORE `which += 1`, while `which` is still the one you just beat.
`turn = 0;` gives you the first move against the new enemy.

steps.title: Play the whole run
steps.instructions: Play to the Ogre. It is hard if you only attack: guard and drink at the right moments. To test the end quickly, change each kind's `hp` in `KINDS` to `1` and Run: three hits win the game, and R starts again from the Slime. Then put the real numbers back (14, 24 and 36).
hints: A kind's numbers are data: changing a number in `KINDS` changes the game, and no other line has to move.

requirements.title: Enemies made from KINDS
requirements.description: Every kind in KINDS becomes a new Fighter, with map or a loop. Help: 7.19.1 (Reading: Kinds as data, map, and levelling up)
requirements.hint: enemies = KINDS.map((k) => new Fighter(k.name, k.hp, k.power, k.potions, k.color));

requirements.title: Beating one brings the next
requirements.description: After a win, which goes up by 1 and the enemy you face becomes the next one in the list. Help: 7.19.1 (Reading: Kinds as data, map, and levelling up)

requirements.title: levelUp raises max hp and power
requirements.description: A method raises this fighter's own max hp and power, and the game calls it after a win. Help: 7.19.1 (Reading: Kinds as data, map, and levelling up)
requirements.hint: levelUp() { this.maxHp += 5; this.hp = this.maxHp; this.power += 1; this.potions = 2; }  and  fighters[0].levelUp();

requirements.title: Beating the last one wins
requirements.description: When the enemy you beat is the last one in the list, the game is over and you have won. Help: 7.19.1 (Reading: Kinds as data, map, and levelling up)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: A run of enemies". The task: keep the enemy kinds as plain data in KINDS and turn them into Fighters with map (or a loop) in newGame; track which enemy you face; write levelUp() so the hero gains max hp, full hp, power and potions; after a win, unless it was the last enemy, add 1 to which, level the hero up and make the next enemy the one you face; beating the last enemy ends the game with a win. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
